meta.name: context-builder
meta.description: Generate interactive AI transformation context-builder prompts for consulting clients. Use when creating structured discovery session prompts that guide a company through context gathering about their business, pain points, tech stack, and AI opportunities. Produces a resumable, multi-section prompt with Express/Deep Dive modes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成结构化的AI转型背景调查提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在咨询项目中系统化收集客户业务与AI机遇信息
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured AI transformation discovery prompts for consulting clients
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically gather client business and AI opportunity info in consulting projects

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过 6 个选择题收集公司信息，然后自动搜索网页和本地笔记，生成一份可反复使用的多段提示文件，内含快问/深潜两种模式。
howto.when: 当你想为咨询客户创建一个结构化的 AI 转型背景收集提示时，例如准备一场关于公司业务、痛点、技术栈的发现会议。

say.text: 帮我为一家 SaaS 公司做一个 AI 转型背景收集提示。
用快问模式生成上次我们聊的那家制造企业的上下文构建提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through 6 multiple-choice questions to gather company info, then automatically searches the web and local notes to generate a reusable multi-section prompt with Express and Deep Dive modes.
howto.when_en: When you need to create a structured AI transformation context-gathering prompt for consulting clients, such as preparing a discovery session on business, pain points, and tech stack.

say_en.text: Create an AI transformation context builder prompt for a SaaS company.
Generate an Express-mode context prompt for that manufacturing client we discussed.
say_en.note: Based on existing notes or input, Claude produces a streamlined version.
